Status is inferred from absence of a closing statement, and the quiet route itself requires #88 orchestration ('Stock GNATprove regenerates that file').

The open items (general native GIMPLE/RTL/assembler/linker phases for the whole grammar, arbitrary-Main Why lifetimes past typing entry, #212 KB/Gprconfig/GPR2/five-report composition, whole-rule evaluator/composition/comparison/review) are the class of work that has historically consumed the most rounds, so effort-weighted completion is probably lower than the 0.33-0.40 count-weighted means.

'Independent review' throughout is intra-workflow review by delegated agents at exact freezes (R92: 'Critical authors/reviewers selected GPT-6 Astra / Extra High; runtime confirmation… unavailable'); I did not verify any arithmetic or source argument, only what the records state.
